description.value: Kingyo is a Japanese izakaya on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, just steps from the Stanley Park seawall cycling network. The restaurant offers a full cocktail program alongside its Japanese menu and runs seasonal omakase courses. It shares ownership with a family of related Japanese concepts across Vancouver, Toronto, and Seattle.
